VERSION: V14b Paired Extension — Expanded Realization-Pair Validation

PROTOCOL.V10_ALGORITHM: V10 scalar Main Macro Critic; two_step_smdp_td; raw 0.01*MSE; 50 Critic steps; clip=0.5.
PROTOCOL.V14B_ALGORITHM: Current + last1 raw 0.01*MSE; last1 norm match; current-priority PCGrad; alpha=1; final norm rescale; clip=0.5; Actor excludes last1.
PROTOCOL.INITIALIZATION: Fresh per arm, seed 27005; no checkpoint reuse.

PILOT_PAIRS.NOTE: These four pairs were inspected in the earlier V14b Fresh5 pilot and are not blind confirmation.

NEW_CONFIRMATORY_PAIRS.NOTE: Primary confirmatory result: 15 previously uninspected pairs, E5->E6 through E19->E20.

ALL_PAIRS.NOTE: Secondary 19-pair aggregate; includes the four previously inspected pilot pairs.

CURRENT_POST_COMPARISON.CURRENT_FIT_RULE: Uses confirmatory mean/median and wins versus losses; does not require every episode to be >= V10.

ALL_VALID_PAIRS.NOTE: Excludes pair 1->2 because source episode E1 has no last1 conflict metric.

PILOT_VALID_PAIRS.NOTE: Pilot correlations are descriptive and not confirmatory.

CONCLUSION.INTERPRETATION: The new-pair Next-pre results show systematic V14b benefit, but the primary conflict-intensity correlation does not meet the mechanism-link threshold. The combined intervention may be useful; replay/retention can account for benefit not linked to conflict severity.
CONCLUSION.CAUSAL_LIMITATION: V10 vs V14b simultaneously changes last1 structured Critic replay/retention, last1 norm matching, and conflict projection. Even strong support only confirms gradient interference as a contributor under the combined V14b intervention; it does not isolate PCGrad projection as the sole cause. No projection-off ablation was run.
